messages:
incidents-bot: PAGER: high traffic + fallback loop detected for routing-policy=smart-fallback (org=acme-corp). Symptoms: elevated 5xxs, cascade to eu-west and ap-south, client retries amplifying traffic. AlertID: AF-4729. Link: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/incidents/AF-4729

alice_sre: I'm oncall. paging me now. Starting triage — pulling up routing logs and slow model variants.

ben_platform: Seen this pattern before — client retries + server-side failover can double traffic. Are clients retrying aggressively? Any recent policy changes on smart-fallback?

cara_runtime: Looking at recent deploys, a policy rollout for smart-fallback to add region affinity went out ~15m ago. I see mapping that routes model=chat-xl -> variant=chat-xl-v2-nq (intended) but some orgs got variant=chat-xl-v2-latency (wrong). That variant lives in only one region and is saturated -> timeouts -> fallback to other region -> clients retry -> loop.

dave_csm: Customer impact: several enterprise customers reporting degraded latency and partial errors for chat endpoints. We're getting support tickets from acme-corp + two others. Need ETA to share with customers.

eve_oncall: Quick mitigation: disabling smart-fallback for org=acme-corp now to prevent cross-region steering. Running: 
```
curl -X POST "https://api.internal.redwood/v1/routing/policies/disable" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"policy_id":"smart-fallback","org_id":"acme-corp"}'
```
Applying now.

deploy-bot: config-change: routing-policy=smart-fallback disabled for org=acme-corp by eve_oncall (change-id: cfg-9921).

frank_sre: Good first step. Also throttle cross-region failover to avoid thundering herd while we fix mapping. I can push a temporary qps cap on failover routes: set `failover.max_rate=50rps/org`.

alice_sre: Doing pass on metrics. Before change failover QPS to eu-west spiked to ~12k; after disable we've seen drop to ~4.5k. Errors still elevated but trending down.

cara_runtime: Root cause summary so far: rollout created an erroneous variant alias for some orgs. Variant hosts are underprovisioned + single-region -> timeouts. Amplification: many clients use naive retry (3x fast backoff) which doubled/tripled traffic when fallback kicked in. We should roll back mapping or correct alias.

ben_platform: Please add temporary server-side circuit breakers so that if a backend variant is failing we'll short-circuit fallback and return a clear 503 to clients instead of triggering failover. Also lower default client retry instructions in SDKs to exponential backoff with jitter.

frank_sre: Pushing throttle now and enabling short-circuit on backend health check: 
```
# rate-limit failover
rbacctl set limit --route failover --org acme-corp --qps 50
# short-circuit config
adminctl put /config/routing/circuit_breakers '{"enabled":true,"failure_threshold":0.2}'
```

deploy-bot: change-applied: failover rate limit + circuit-breaker enabled (change-id: cfg-9922).

alice_sre: After both changes, request amplification stopped. Retries to alternate regions fell ~80%. Latency for affected customers back to acceptable for most requests.

dave_csm: Drafting customer message: "We've mitigated the immediate issue by disabling the fallback policy for your org and throttling cross-region failovers. Our engineers are investigating a policy mapping bug and will follow up with RCA and timeline for permanent fix." Want me to send now?

cara_runtime: Yes send that. We'll follow up with patch: update policy mapping and add a canary validation to the policy rollout to prevent wrong variant mapping. Also we'll implement server-side retry budgeting so clients can't amplify failover.

ben_platform: Action items: 1) revert or fix policy mapping for all orgs, 2) add canary checks + validation in rollout pipeline, 3) SDK guidance update and stricter default retries, 4) permanent circuit-breaker + rate-limit defaults.

frank_sre: I'll own immediate postmortem and timeline. Captured logs and sample trace: `trace_id=tx-8b3e` shows repeated retries from client leading to failover calls.

alice_sre: Handoff: I'm off shift in 30m. frank_sre will take primary for next 2h. frank, summarize any remaining runbooks?

frank_sre: Taking over. Runbook notes: watch failover qps, backend error rate, and front-door retry count. If failover qps > 1000 for any region, re-enable org-level disable and escalate.

dave_csm: Sent customer notes to acme-corp and two other customers. Will update when we have ETA.

eve_oncall: Confirming metrics: frontend retries dropped from ~18k to ~3k in the last 10m. Error rate for chat endpoints decreased from 7% -> 1.2%.

cara_runtime: Planning fix: patch pipeline to validate variant alias against catalog and region availability before rollout. Target PR and deploy today in canary; full rollout tomorrow morning.

alice_sre: Thanks team. Marking incident as mitigated for paging. We'll keep thread open for RCA and postmortem. :lock:

frank_sre: Incident capture: AF-4729 Mitigated -> monitoring will watch for 2h then close. RCA owner: cara_runtime. PM: dave_csm.

deploy-bot: incident-state: mitigated (AF-4729) by frank_sre.

cara_runtime: I'll start the RCA doc and include suggested changes to routing logic + retry budget.

frank_sre: I'll hand this off to oncall rotation. If anything flares, re-pager.

alice_sre: Leaving channel, good handoff.

frank_sre: last note: consider adding a short-term SDK patch that warns customers when they hit a fallback loop and suggests client-side backoff.

dave_csm: Thanks all — will schedule customer follow-up meeting in 1h.

incidents-bot: NOTE: no current pagers for this incident. Monitoring will reopen if thresholds hit."
